text: {"lessons":["After selling Stock D at a gain and buying it back, I’ll remember that realizing a gain feels good but does not by itself make a trade worthwhile.","I made no trades for several periods while my account value rose overall; I don’t need to trade just because I check my account often.","I’ll judge each holding by its prospects rather than treating my average cost or whether I’m up or down as a reason to sell or hold; past price moves don’t predict future ones."]}
